description: Gelato brings AIOStreams (Stremio addons) into Jellyfin. Search results and imported catalogs show up as regular movies and series, and streams are resolved when you press play and proxied through Jellyfin.
name: Gelato
overview: Stremio addons as Jellyfin library items: search, catalogs and on-demand streams through AIOStreams.

versions.changelog:
## [0.26.29.0] - 2026-10-24

### 🚀 Features

- Exclude uncached streams from pre-probing (#336)
- Show a version's tracks as soon as they are known (#340)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Show that more settings tabs exist on a phone (#330)
- Keep an episode edit made during its refresh (#331)
- Keep a deleted series gone when trees go off (#332)
- Stop a queued pre-probe once pre-probing is off (#333)
- Draw the setup's cone like the logo (#335)
- Keep an episode edit made as its series refreshes (#337)
- Hide one-movie collections, keep search titles hidden (#338)
- Reopen a series deleted right after it was added (#339)
- Keep a split row's watch state when a probe ends after the split (#343)
- No error logged for a probe of a deleted title (#342)
- Probe a stream once when a page is opened twice (#341)
- Open a title again from search after it left your own folder (#345)
- Keep a series deleted after marking it played (#344)
- List a new series' seasons from the first open (#347)

### ⚡ Performance

- Open the item menu without waiting for streams (#346)

### 🚜 Refactor

- Sort Gelato's wrappers around Jellyfin (#334)
